name: Survey Dataset
abstract: A geometric survey dataset (point cloud, photogrammetric model or similar) acquired from a heritage asset, modelled as a CRMdig D1 Digital Object with a CRMdig D7 acquisition event and a spatial coverage geometry. Profiles ogc.heritage.digital-representation, adding survey acquisition paradata (method, equipment, CRS, density, accuracy) and a mandatory coverage polygon.

sources.title: CRMdig D1 Digital Object / D7 Digital Machine Event
